name: Example: Finding an Entry of the Product of Two Matrices
problem:
Let $Z=XY.$ What is the value of $z_{32}$, if

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -2 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Multiplying the $3$rd row in $X$ by the $2$nd column in $Y$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{z}_{32} & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =1\cdot (-1)+2\cdot 4+3\cdot (-2) \\  & =-1+8-6 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
